title: Gustaf Rydberg (1835-1933)
content: Gustaf Rydberg(1835-1933) was a Swedish landscape painter.He studied atThe Düsseldorf Academyin Germany with the mastersHans Fredrik GudeandOswald Achenbach.Those teachers were masters of lighting. Rydberg focused on plein-air painting. As he did so he was inspired byJean-Baptiste-Camille Corot.According toNordic Landscape Painting in the Nineteenth Century,"the ground in Rydberg's paintings is often worn into paths and tracks of wagons or other human activities, all reinforcing the impresssion of a real world that has not been rearranged to fulfill aesthetic criteria."--Gustaf Rydberg on WikipediaBook:Nordic Landscape Painting in the Nineteenth Century
